s = input().strip()

result = ""
result += s[0]

rest = s[1:]

# Replace first "at"
at_pos = rest.find("at")
if at_pos != -1:
    rest = rest[:at_pos] + "@" + rest[at_pos + 2:]

# Replace all "dot" except at the end
while True:
    dot_pos = rest.find("dot")
    if dot_pos == -1 or dot_pos == len(rest) - 3:
        break
    rest = rest[:dot_pos] + "." + rest[dot_pos + 3:]

print(result + rest)
</translated_code>
